title: GAIP Envelope
description: Gaiko Agentic Interoperability Protocol v1.0 — the only shared contract between participants. A participant deserializes this and nothing else.

protocol_version.description: Major must match the peer's. Minor versions are additive by contract.

message_id.description: Unique per message. Used for deduplication and tracing.

correlation_id.description: The task this message belongs to. A reply inherits it, which is what makes replies routable with no session state.

message_type.description: The closed vocabulary. Six primitives, no invented verbs.

payload.description: Typed body, defined per intent. Artifacts above ~8 MiB travel by reference (artifacts_ref), never inline.

agentUrn.description: urn:agent:<runtime>:<framework>:<name>[:<version>] — the runtime and framework are part of the address on purpose.
